results.id: synthetic operator login succeeds and returns a CSRF token
cookie-authenticated PUT without x-csrf-token is rejected
authenticated operator can save a talisman change
stock quantity persists and reaches the customer catalog
pricing is preserved by the save
render-tuning fields are preserved by the save
the API still lists an inactive talisman (visibility is not a server-side filter)
an inactive talisman can be re-activated by the authorized update path
the re-activated save keeps the protected render-tuning fields
POSTing an existing id is refused with 409 (the failure a POST-instead-of-PUT edit would hit)
updating an id the catalog does not store is refused with 404 (the stale catalog list case)
zero stock keeps the talisman active (fulfillment state and design eligibility stay separate)
